in_lock.$comment:
DPIDs handled IN-LOCK and never forwarded to the MCU. These are OURS — our BLE bond-management channel, not Tuya datapoints — so they are product-INDEPENDENT and belong on every profile.

They lived only on ozkie-legacy-v0 until it was deleted 2026-08-20, which would have silently removed bond revoke / invite cancel / list bonds from every real product. Verified unallocated in the manufacturer space on DS013-T3; re-verify against any new supplier's DP list before assuming the same, because 101-103 are not reserved by Tuya.
